# SpotLift
> Python-native econometric library for minute-by-minute Linear TV and CTV attribution across Google Analytics 4 (GA4) and Amazon Seller/Vendor Central.

## Core Capabilities
- **Open-Source Core (`pip install spotlift`):**
  - 21-day diurnal rolling median baseline de-trending with 15-minute pre-spot level calibration.
  - Minute-level single-spot incremental lift integration for GA4 sessions and conversions.
  - Automated overlapping spot collision detection across broadcast channels.
- **SpotLift Pro (`spotlift.install_pro(api_key)`):**
  - Expectation-Maximization (EM) multi-spot deconvolution using Shifted-Gamma impulse response kernels.
  - Dual-stage TV-to-Amazon Distributed Lag attribution (linking immediate Amazon App search spikes to 1–36h delayed unit orders).
  - Amazon Branded PPC Cannibalization Auditor (separating genuine TV organic halo from Sponsored Brands click interception) + AMC Clean Room SQL generator.
  - Automated Post-Buy Efficiency Matrix (Station, Daypart, Program Genre, Pod Position, Creative Wear-out) exported to interactive HTML and Excel.

## Quickstart
```python
import spotlift as sl

airings = sl.load_airings("tv_schaltplan.csv")
ga4 = sl.load_telemetry("ga4_minute_sessions.parquet")
amz = sl.load_telemetry("amazon_hourly_orders_and_ppc.csv")

# Free baseline & collision check
report = sl.analyze_spots(airings, ga4, window_minutes=8)

# Pro EM Deconvolution & Amazon Halo (requires SpotLift Pro license key)
pro_audit = sl.analyze_omnichannel_pro(
    airings=airings,
    web_telemetry=ga4,
    amazon_telemetry=amz,
    export_html="client_tv_postbuy_audit.html"
)
```
